thread:
rachel.b: hi all — need help adding my nephew as a dependent. Temporary guardianship started 2026-07-15 and he moved in. Can I add him mid-year and make coverage retro to the move-in date? SSN pending.

people-ops: welcome — sorry for the paperwork mix. Short answer: yes, usually allowed as a mid-year qualifying event (change in household). We need guardianship docs + proof of residence.

benefits-ops: requirements and next steps: please submit a dependent addition in Workday Benefits selecting event = 'change in household/guardianship'. Attach the docs below. We'll file with carrier as a manual mid-year add and request retro effective 2026-07-15.

benefits-ops: required docs (upload all that apply):
```
- temporary guardianship order or court filing
- proof of new residence (driver's license, school enrollment, utility bill)
- birth certificate of the child
- SSN (if pending, mark "SSN pending" and upload when available)
```

rachel.b: great — how long does carrier approval usually take and will payroll backdate deductions?

benefits-ops: carrier response typically 5-10 business days. If approved retro to 7/15, payroll will process a catch-up deduction on the next monthly payroll after we confirm. If you'd prefer spread-out catch-up, note that in your Workday request and payroll can usually split over 2-3 pay cycles.

payroll-bot: payroll note: deduction change posts after benefits sends change to payroll and we hit our cutoff. Expected refund/catch-up timing: if benefits confirms before 2026-07-25 cut-off -> appears on 2026-07-31 pay; otherwise 2026-08-31 pay. Catch-ups are taxable and follow normal withholding.

rachel.b: thanks. Any privacy/legal stuff I should be careful about when uploading docs?

legal: don't upload unredacted SSNs for other adults in the file names, and use the secure Workday upload only. If documents are international, include certified translations.

benefits-ops: update: received docs (REQ-2432109876). We've opened carrier ticket REF-REQ-2432109876 and requested retro to 2026-07-15. Will update thread when carrier responds. If carrier denies retro, we'll still add effective the carrier's earliest allowed date and coordinate payroll.

rachel.b: uploaded everything and noted spread over 2 pays if possible. Really appreciate the help — this is a huge relief :heart:
